headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Two Major Russian Oil Refineries in Samara Region
summary: Ukrainian overnight drone strikes targeted two major oil refineries in Russia's Samara region, expanding a campaign that has disrupted 16 facilities since early November.
why: Attacks on Russian refining infrastructure restrict domestic fuel production capacity and influence regional petroleum supply chains.
why_moved: Ongoing drone strikes against key energy production and refining assets escalate geopolitical supply risks in major oil-exporting nations.
